notes.title: We're shutting down!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

Due to recent events, we regret to announce that Generic Game Studios will be shutting down in the coming days. As a result, our title 'The Valley in my Mind' is also going to be removed from Steam as there is too little demand for the title to stay up. Currently the game is free for purchase, and anyone who installs the game should have it as long as they do not delete the game from their hard drive. However by the end of next week, the game will no longer be downloadable from Steam of any other game distribution site. 

Best Regards,
Generic Game Studios LLC
